handoff_derivation: Only import mainchip_built_engine_route_tail_contract as c changes to mainchip_fixed_engine_route_tail_contract as c. All other bytes unchanged, including original canonical path helper, exact route/freeze/restore gates, full archives and immutable current-source projection.

preserved_contract_bodies_required.complete: Original full three-result/five-audit gate and repair.require_complete unchanged.
preserved_contract_bodies_required.compare_cases: Original complete off/on geometry and DRC comparison unchanged; no added fixed-clock internal conservation acceptance.
preserved_contract_bodies_required.stage_limits: Original route driver14700/inner15000/container15180 and audit driver6300/inner6600/container6780 seconds unchanged.
preserved_contract_bodies_required.timing: Original20/4/8/8ns +5% unchanged; no timing or physical acceptance.

new_contract_interface.previous: mainchip_fixed_engine_route_prefix_contract from the immutable frozen prefix source; never the old built-engine prefix contract.
new_contract_interface.group: Distinct per mode/stage reserved release groups; existing off/on route/audit and comparison semantics.

new_hooks.saved_path(name): Protected relative path to actual fresh prefix record; used for outputs and frozen-prefix-inventory exact byte fingerprints. Avoid old dot-suffix storage layout.
new_hooks.saved(root,name): Authentic current prefix JSON, retaining immutable original bytes; no old receipt substitution.
new_hooks.authorize_stage(method,stage): Typed current source/controller and exact route/audit authority; no native allowance inherited from prefix. Called before host work/download and before each driver/inner/audit native execution.
new_hooks.control_evidence(root,ctx): Authenticate exact current source/run/mode/stage controls; return basename ending -controls.json -> {bytes,sha256}. Copies rehashed before any acquisition.
new_hooks.SOURCE_ADMISSION: Protected new source admission document, copied into output.
new_hooks.validate_reservation(proof,ctx,empty): Exact new source/run/attempt/group/stage/mode/tag/release binding; empty before acquisition.
new_hooks.direct_plan(out,names): Unchanged qualified empty-file plan; names may be safe root files or generated supervision/witness relative members. Publisher adds explicit basename asset_name and rejects duplicate upload names.

actual_prefix_fields_pending: complete frozen file map and count
exact current fixed.odb and repair.tcl receipts
new_contract_interface.source_projection: Pin/copy the complete new tail map plus its method and every recursively read prior method/proof document. Preserve the exact full actual prefix source projection independently in /work/source and new tail projection in /work/tail-source.

module_resolution.reason: Frozen prefix deliberately wins for original native helpers. Distinct fixed-engine tail modules prevent historical tail modules already in frozen source from shadowing current code.
module_resolution.native_renderer: Use mainchip_fixed_engine_route_prefix_native, whose canonical renderer is unchanged; original mainchip_two_signal_repair_native and mainchip_original_clock_restoration_native must still resolve under /work/source/scripts.

restore_changes.metadata_paths: Only two old c.PREFIX dot-suffix assumptions replaced with saved_path.
restore_changes.complete_restore_unchanged: Full outer and nested archives, exact all-member extractor, no collisions/symlinks, immutable full projected file hashes and actual FROZEN_BYTES retained.

publication.direct_plan: Every selected root/native stream records original relative archive_member, SHA/bytes/disposition and release asset_name basename; all duplicate upload basenames refused.
publication.directory_guards: Do not follow supervision/witness symlinks before plan reads. Original full-tree special-entry guard and complete publication disk guard retained.

native_and_acceptance.historical_failure: Three shorts and zero two-target geometry delta remain original failure evidence. The prior selected fixed-clock0.84um internal change is not erased or presumed repaired; any conservation diagnostic is separate future work.

next_bounded_steps: Root completes and authenticates actual new prefix run; source/run status alone is not input admission.
Root supplies strict actual-prefix-bound contract, new disabled method/flags and exact current source controls; keep actual full source projection and recursive method pins.

Hosted tests must exercise actual new helper calls, complete synthetic route handoff/refusals and source/authority/publication/lifecycle failures; no native qualification can come from those synthetic controls.
Use independent route/audit reservations, unchanged14400s route and five1200s audits, and hosted job wall-clock envelopes that also retain restore/freeze/publication under360min.
Root alone may authorize exact-source native work after review and actual controls. No dispatch is performed by this source unit.
